title: Send FlowWeb's lead-hunt messages from Frequency: signed, off by default, suppression and a daily cap, with unsubscribe, postal address and, when asked, a posted event with its claim link

source.ref: FlowWeb row FW-C-041 (saved event lead hunts). Daniel, 2026-11-10: 'set up auto hunts for events, find their creators email or contact info ... send them a customized lead message with a claim link. The building stuff / claim link can be a second selectible layer.'

detail:
POST /api/webhooks/flowweb-outreach takes one FlowWeb outbox item, signed as hex HMAC-SHA256 of `${x-flowweb-timestamp}.${body}` under FLOWWEB_OUTREACH_SECRET (5 minute window; no secret = 401). The item must name a deliverable address, the public page it came from (which the body must quote) and carry FlowWeb's 'reply no' opt-out. Gates in order: FLOWWEB_OUTREACH_ENABLED (envFlag, off by default, answers off), FLOWWEB_OUTREACH_REPLY_TO set, suppression (global or the root Space's own opt-outs, fail-closed), daily cap (FLOWWEB_OUTREACH_DAILY_CAP, default 50, counted on outreach_sends), unsubscribe link. With build, the event is posted for its organizer through the existing poster-events claim spine (seed owner as poster, published 'posted', organizer contact stamped after publish so the stock claim email is not sent twice) and {{claim_url}} is filled with /events/claim/<token>; a retried item reuses its event (events.details.flowweb.item_id). The send is the queue's email job, deduped on flowweb:<id>, with the root-Space unsubscribe link, List-Unsubscribe headers and the postal line. Pure rules in lib/flowweb/outreach.ts, IO in lib/flowweb/outreach-io.ts, runbook gate in docs/RUNBOOKS.md. Probe: scripts/probes/flowweb-outreach.mjs.

Endpoint, gates and claim build shipped; switch stays off until the RUNBOOKS gate passes.
